notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Leaderboard Enhancements

[list]
[*] Improved font support for better readability, including Asian, Greek, and Cyrillic characters.
[*] Increased the leaderboard entry limit to 500 for a more competitive ranking.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain special characters were not displaying correctly.
[*] Minor stability improvements for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for your support!
